seo.description: Study Bachelor's in Electronics and Communication Engineering in Australia for Indian students. Learn about top universities (RMIT, UNSW, QUT, Curtin), eligibility, fees, accreditation, and career opportunities.

hero.title: Australian undergraduate communication and electronics engineering programs.
hero.subtitle: Electronics and communication engineering drives modern telecommunications, microelectronics, wireless networks, satellite communications, and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies.

overview: Undergraduate programs focus on analog and digital circuits, microprocessors, signal processing, antenna design, optical communications, and next-generation mobile networks (5G/6G).

faq.question: Is it possible for Indian students to study communication and electronics engineering in Australia?
faq.answer: Yes, qualified students can apply after completing Class 12 with mathematics and physics.

faq.question: What is the duration of an Australian degree in communication and electronics engineering?
faq.answer: The standard course duration is 4 years of full-time study for an accredited honours degree.

faq.question: Does communication and electronics engineering require mathematics?
faq.answer: Yes, advanced mathematics is a compulsory prerequisite for admission.

faq.question: Do Australian universities require NEET for electronics engineering?
faq.answer: No, NEET is not required for engineering admissions in Australia.

faq.question: How much does communication and electronics engineering cost in Australia?
faq.answer: Annual international tuition generally ranges between AUD 39,000 and AUD 53,000.
